perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective, available information:

- Recommender greeted me and asked what kind of movie I’m looking for.
- I said I’m looking for any genre with a woman in the lead, because I’m in the mood for a good heroine.
- Recommender suggested *The Blind Side* (2009) with Sandra Bullock.
- I said I haven’t seen it, and asked if it’s the one about her adopting the black kid. Recommender confirmed and said it’s really good.
- Recommender suggested *The Help* (2011) with Emma Stone and Viola Davis.
- I said I’ll rent it tonight, and that I did see *The Help*; it made me cry and laugh throughout.
- Recommender said they loved *The Help* and really likes *Precious*, about a girl whose mother is mean to her.
- I said I tried to watch *Precious* but couldn’t because it was too sad; it brought back memories of being overweight in my early 20s.
- Recommender said *Precious* was awful and she had to deal with so much.
- Recommender suggested *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* (2011), another Sandra Bullock film.
- I asked if it’s based on the novel of the same name. Recommender wasn’t sure, and described it as about an autistic boy who loses his father on 9/11.
- I confirmed that’s the one. I’ve read and loved the book, never seen the movie, and cried through the entire book.
- Recommender said *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* is very sad but very good.
- Recommender said they’ll have to read the book now, and suggested *Breakfast at Tiffany’s* (1961).

Personal/previous information available to me:
- I have not seen *The Blind Side*.
- I have seen *The Help*; it made me cry and laugh.
- I tried to watch *Precious* but found it too sad; it reminded me of being overweight in my early 20s.
- I have read and loved *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close*, cried through the book, and have never seen the movie.
- I want a film of any genre with a woman in the lead; I’m in the mood for a good heroine.
